---
title: "Excitation-Inhibition Balance Tuning via tvboptim"
---

Reproducing the FIC+EIB tuning workflow from [Schirner et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-38626-y). Fits local inhibitory weights (J_i) for E-I balance and dual coupling weights (wLRE, wFFI) to match empirical functional connectivity.

```{python}
# | output: false
import os

os.environ["XLA_FLAGS"] = "--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=8"

from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Load experiment (network + target FC loaded from BIDS automatically)
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file(
    "/Users/leonmartin_bih/tools/tvbo/database/experiments/EI_Tuning_FIC_EIB_Optimization.yaml"
)
print(exp.render_code('tvboptim'))
```

```{python}
results = exp.run("tvboptim", mode="all")
```


## Results
```{python}
# | label: fig-ei-tuning-results
# | fig-cap: "**EI Tuning Results.** Row 1: FIC algorithm. Row 2: FIC+EIB combined. Row 3: EIB post-FIC. Row 4: Gradient-based optimization."
# | fig-height: 16

cmap = plt.cm.cividis
accent_blue = cmap(0.3)
accent_gold = cmap(0.85)
accent_mid = cmap(0.6)

# Get FC matrices directly from stored observations (no post-hoc computation!)
fc_target = np.array(results.observations.fc_target)
fc_post_fic = np.array(results.fic.post_tuning_observations.fc)
fc_post_fic_eib = np.array(results.fic_eib.post_tuning_observations.fc)
fc_post_eib = np.array(results.eib.post_tuning_observations.fc)
fc_gradient = np.array(results.gradient_eib.post_optimization_observations.fc)

# FC correlations from post-tuning observations (computed from fresh simulation, not last iteration)
# This matches original which runs eval_fc() after tuning for final metrics
corr_post_fic = float(results.fic.post_tuning_observations.fc_corr)
corr_fic_eib = float(results.fic_eib.post_tuning_observations.fc_corr)
corr_eib = float(results.eib.post_tuning_observations.fc_corr)
corr_gradient = float(results.gradient_eib.post_optimization_observations.fc_corr)

# 4 rows x 4 columns layout
mosaic = "AABBCCDD\nEEFFGGHH\nIIJJKKLL\nMMNNOOPP"
fig, axes = plt.subplot_mosaic(mosaic, figsize=(16, 14))

# =============================================================================
# ROW 1: FIC Algorithm Results (Local E-I Balance Tuning)
# =============================================================================

# A: S_e Before FIC
ax = axes["A"]
data = np.array(results.fic.pre_tuning.data[:, 0, :])
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(i / data.shape[1]), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls="--", lw=2, label="Target")
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="A. FIC: Before Tuning")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend(loc="upper right")

# B: S_e After FIC
ax = axes["B"]
data = np.array(results.fic.post_tuning.data[:, 0, :])
for i in range(data.shape[1]):
    ax.plot(data[:, i], color=cmap(i / data.shape[1]), lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls="--", lw=2, label="Target")
ax.set(xlabel="Time step", ylabel="S_e", title="B. FIC: After Tuning")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.legend(loc="upper right")

# C: FIC Convergence (Mean S_e over iterations)
ax = axes["C"]
ax.plot(np.array(results.fic.history.mean_S_e), lw=2, color=accent_blue, label="Mean S_e")
ax.axhline(0.25, color=accent_gold, ls="--", lw=2, label="Target")
ax.set(xlabel="FIC iteration", ylabel="Mean S_e", title="C. FIC: Convergence")
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# D: J_i Distribution (fitted inhibitory weights)
ax = axes["D"]
J_i = np.array(results.fic.state.dynamics.J_i).flatten()
ax.bar(range(len(J_i)), J_i, alpha=0.7, color=accent_mid)
ax.set(xlabel="Region", ylabel="J_i", title="D. FIC: Fitted J_i")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis="y")

# =============================================================================
# ROW 2: FIC+EIB Combined Algorithm Results
# =============================================================================

# E: FC Target (empirical)
ax = axes["E"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_target)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="E. Target FC (Empirical)")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# F: FC after FIC+EIB
ax = axes["F"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_post_fic_eib)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title=f"F. FIC+EIB FC (r={corr_fic_eib:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# G: FIC+EIB Convergence (FC correlation)
ax = axes["G"]
ax2 = ax.twinx()
(l1,) = ax.plot(np.array(results.fic_eib.history.fc_corr), lw=2, color=accent_blue, label="FC Corr")
(l2,) = ax2.plot(np.array(results.fic_eib.history.fc_rmse), lw=2, color=accent_gold, label="FC RMSE")
ax.set(xlabel="FIC+EIB iteration", ylabel="FC Correlation", title="G. FIC+EIB: Convergence")
ax2.set_ylabel("FC RMSE")
ax.legend(handles=[l1, l2], loc="center right")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# H: FIC+EIB wLRE
ax = axes["H"]
wLRE = np.array(results.fic_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wLRE)
im = ax.imshow(wLRE, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="H. FIC+EIB: wLRE")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# =============================================================================
# ROW 3: EIB Post-FIC Algorithm Results
# =============================================================================

# I: FC after FIC only (before EIB refinement)
ax = axes["I"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_post_fic)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title=f"I. Post-FIC FC (r={corr_post_fic:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# J: FC after EIB-post-FIC
ax = axes["J"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_post_eib)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title=f"J. EIB-post-FIC FC (r={corr_eib:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# K: EIB Convergence (FC correlation)
ax = axes["K"]
ax2 = ax.twinx()
(l1,) = ax.plot(np.array(results.eib.history.fc_corr), lw=2, color=accent_blue, label="FC Corr")
(l2,) = ax2.plot(np.array(results.eib.history.fc_rmse), lw=2, color=accent_gold, label="FC RMSE")
ax.set(xlabel="EIB iteration", ylabel="FC Correlation", title="K. EIB: Convergence")
ax2.set_ylabel("FC RMSE")
ax.legend(handles=[l1, l2], loc="center right")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# L: EIB wLRE
ax = axes["L"]
wLRE = np.array(results.eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wLRE)
im = ax.imshow(wLRE, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="L. EIB: wLRE")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# =============================================================================
# ROW 4: Gradient-Based Optimization Results
# =============================================================================

# M: FC after Gradient Optimization
ax = axes["M"]
fc_plot = np.copy(fc_gradient)
np.fill_diagonal(fc_plot, np.nan)
im = ax.imshow(fc_plot, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title=f"M. Gradient FC (r={corr_gradient:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# N: Gradient Loss Convergence
ax = axes["N"]
loss_values = np.array(results.gradient_eib.history['loss'].save.tolist())
ax.plot(loss_values, lw=2, color="k", alpha=0.9)
ax.scatter(0, loss_values[0], s=80, color=accent_blue, zorder=5)
ax.scatter(len(loss_values) - 1, loss_values[-1], s=80, color=accent_gold, zorder=5)
ax.set(xlabel="Optimization Step", ylabel="Combined Loss", title="N. Gradient: Loss Convergence")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# O: wLRE after Gradient
ax = axes["O"]
wLRE_grad = np.array(results.gradient_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wLRE)
im = ax.imshow(wLRE_grad, cmap="cividis")
wLRE_grad_corr = np.corrcoef(wLRE_grad.flatten(), fc_target.flatten())[0, 1]
ax.set(title=f"O. Gradient: wLRE (r={wLRE_grad_corr:.3f})")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

# P: wFFI after Gradient
ax = axes["P"]
wFFI_grad = np.array(results.gradient_eib.state.coupling.EIBLinearCoupling.wFFI)
im = ax.imshow(wFFI_grad, cmap="cividis")
ax.set(title="P. Gradient: wFFI")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# =============================================================================
# Summary Statistics
# =============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("EI TUNING SUMMARY")
print("=" * 60)

print(f"\nFIC (Local E-I Balance):")
print(f"  Final Mean S_e: {results.fic.history.mean_S_e[-1]:.4f} (target: 0.25)")
print(f"  J_i range: [{J_i.min():.3f}, {J_i.max():.3f}]")
print(f"  FC correlation: {corr_post_fic:.4f}")

print(f"\nFIC+EIB (Combined Algorithm):")
print(f"  Final FC correlation: {corr_fic_eib:.4f}")
print(f"  Final FC RMSE: {results.fic_eib.history.fc_rmse[-1]:.4f}")

print(f"\nEIB (Post-FIC Refinement):")
print(f"  Final FC correlation: {corr_eib:.4f}")
print(f"  Final FC RMSE: {results.eib.history.fc_rmse[-1]:.4f}")

print(f"\nGradient-Based Optimization:")
print(f"  Final FC correlation: {corr_gradient:.4f}")
print(f"  Final combined loss: {loss_values[-1]:.4f}")
print(f"  Improvement over FIC+EIB: Δr = {corr_gradient - corr_fic_eib:+.4f}")
```
